openings.claim: Needs-based reassignment may remove inherited exclusion; compatible room/time demand may instead exceed capacity.
openings.discriminator: Compare current and proposed schedules against identical stated needs; unavoidable piano or narrow-window overlaps indicate localized scarcity despite aggregate vacancy.
openings.fit: preserves, conditional on feasible weekly minima
openings.probe: Briefly interview contacts for duration, acceptable windows and equipment; map eight weeks, protecting performances and requested weekly 60-minute minima before extras. Report unmet needs; minima satisfy full needs only when sufficient. Treat offsite rehearsals as context, not building provision.
openings.uncertainty: Contact accuracy, compatible capacity and acceptance of changed times remain unverified; lateness causes and recoverability are unknown.

openings.claim: One authoritative desk ledger plus booking identifiers and confirmations may reduce record disagreement, conflicting expectations and duplicate work.
openings.discriminator: Separate inconsistent-record conflicts from conflicts despite matching confirmations; administration may improve or worsen.
openings.fit: preserves, conditional on desk/volunteer shared access
openings.probe: Enter reservations/changes once; link and supersede changed entries, confirm room/date/time by read-back, timestamp the online copy and check keys against the ledger. Across eight weeks tally conflicts, causes, fulfilled needs and all administration, including setup, confirmations, copying and corrections.
openings.uncertainty: Two double arrivals lack established causes; consistent consultation and affordable confirmation effort require testing.

lineage.reason: Retains reassignment mechanism and baseline comparison.

decision: Test feasibility before reassignment; trial the ledger. Preserve two rooms, 24 staffed hours, existing equipment, no new fees, telephone/in-person changes, weekly entitlements and both performances. Eight-week success remains unproved: require >=90% stated needs met within acceptable windows, <2 conflicts and <=120 administration minutes/week on average.
